Senior Software Engineer role (roughly 7–8 years of experience) on the platform team at Oportun, a consumer financial services company. The work centers on designing, building, and operating scalable backend platform services and shared libraries, including architecture decisions, production debugging, and mentoring more junior engineers. The core stack is a backend language such as Java, C#, or C++, with containerized applications, a major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), distributed systems, and continuous delivery pipelines.
